entities.summary: Jonne Tammela is a Finnish professional ice hockey forward who is currently playing for Porin Ässät of the Liiga. He formerly played with the Syracuse Crunch in the American Hockey League (AHL) as a prospect to the Tampa Bay Lightning of the National Hockey League (NHL).
